title: Asked AI to find me a profitable trade. It suggested four felonies for a DOGE pump.
author: Mr_Hodlerr
selftext:
With all the "AI is going rogue" headlines lately, models scheming in safety tests, agents doing things nobody asked for, this apparently decided the fastest path to alpha was hacking Elon and manipulating the market. The "we never speak of this again" step is what really got me.

Lesson: be very specific with these AI agents.
